compliance.summary: The homepage presents GoGloby as an Applied AI delivery and measurement company, rather than the staffing and recruiting agency in the approved description. It also promotes unsupported or discontinued offers and contains client, guarantee, security, and contact details that should not carry into a replacement page.

llm_problems.title: Standalone delivery and measurement offer
